_help: Gallery for each machine. 'base' is the folder for local files. Each image is a URL (https://...) or a file name inside base (photo.jpg), or a full path starting with assets/. Use the object form to add a caption, a credit, or to force 'type': 'url' or 'file'. Missing or broken images are skipped. Add images under 'missions' using the mission id. 'queries' (optional): { mission id: search words } fills each machine up to 'perMachine' pictures from NASA's open image library (images-api.nasa.gov) when your own list has fewer.

surveyor-3.caption: Surveyor 3 in its crater on the Moon, photographed by Apollo 12 astronauts in November 1969.

apollo-11-eagle.caption: The Apollo 11 lunar module Eagle on the Moon.

viking-1.caption: Line drawing of the Viking lander.
The first picture Viking 1 took on the surface of Mars, minutes after landing.

sojourner.caption: Sojourner on the Martian surface after rolling off the Pathfinder lander (Sol 2).
Pathfinder and Sojourner on the surface, with the landing airbags deflated.
Sojourner deploying its Alpha Proton X-ray Spectrometer (animated).

spirit.caption: Spirit's landing site in Gusev Crater, with the crumpled airbags around the landing platform (Sol 16).

opportunity.caption: Opportunity's self-portrait, March 2014: wind had cleaned much of the dust off its solar panels.
The "Lion King" panorama of Eagle Crater and the plains of Meridiani Planum.
